<noinclude>
Template for displaying protocol/SOP information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Protocol
|title=Cell Culture Protocol
|category=Safety
|version=2.1
|author=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]
|created_date=2024-01-15
|last_review_date=2025-01-10
|next_review_date=2026-01-10
|status=Active
|required_equipment=[[Equipment:Confocal Microscope]]; [[Equipment:Centrifuge]]
|required_certifications=[[Safety Certification:Biosafety Level 2]]
|related_protocols=[[Protocol:Cell Harvesting]]; [[Protocol:Cell Staining]]
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* title - Protocol title (required)
* category - Protocol category (Safety, Experimental, Maintenance, etc.)
* version - Version number
* author - Link to personnel page
* created_date - Creation date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* last_review_date - Last review date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* next_review_date - Next scheduled review date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* status - Status (Active, Inactive, Under Review)
* required_equipment - Semicolon-separated list of equipment links
* required_certifications - Semicolon-separated list of certification links
* related_protocols - Semicolon-separated list of related protocol links

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
